powdery-mildew: Apply a fungicide, an herbal nutrient, and medicine for the eggplant.
If no fungicide is available, apply natural remedies such as vinegar, milk, or sodium bicarbonate.
target spot: Cut the portion of the leaf that has disease, if worse cut the stem of that leaf.
Moisten it every day and put some fertilizer to your eggplant.
spotted wilt: Make sure to cut the stem of this eggplant then incinerate it so the bacteria wouldn’t spread across others.
After burning, throw it in a trash can, not just somewhere.
